snippet.title: Spells & Secrets - Release Date Trailer ✨🔮
snippet.description:
Prepare for the magical adventure of a lifetime! ✨ Spells & Secrets arrives on Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch on November 9th, where you'll craft your Wizard Student and journey into a mesmerizing world brimming with wonder and unraveling secrets. 🧙‍♂️

Features:
🌟 Customize your wizard student
🏰 Explore the ever-changing Castle of Greifenstein
💥 Master powerful spells and unlock more
🗺️ Delve into exploration like never before
👫 Join forces in local co-op gameplay
🌄 A world of fantasy, puzzles, and adventure awaits

🖤 Wishlist now on Steam: https://bit.ly/46wZyit 
💙 Wishlist now on PS5: https://bit.ly/3rwOfrL
